summary: 硬件公司经营模拟，2026 年 10 月 16 日上市，Roastery Games 开发并发行。商店披露只有一句：生成式 AI 被用于协助制作游戏内部分虚构公司 logo。八个领域仅登记美术一处为已使用，游玩时生成、代码、音乐、配音、文本、翻译与营销本次披露未说明。
reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商与发行商均为 Roastery Games）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 249），首页没有命中 AI 关键词的主题，因此没有可读取的相关帖。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 1 篇原始来源：GameDB.ai 本作条目把披露概括为“AI 协助制作了游戏内部分虚构公司 logo”，该站自述其 AI 标签读自各游戏的 Steam 披露，属转录。其余结果为本作商店页与同一商店页的推荐位入口、一个 Instagram 短视频条目、另一款近似名称游戏（TechDev Tycoon）的比价条目页，以及一个 Reddit 游戏设计版块的开发帖——标题为“我在做一个 tycoon 游戏”，未标明即本作，且本机直连与代理两条通道均无法读取全文，未登记为来源。检索结果为空只说明本次检索范围，不能据此证明没有 AI。八个领域全部按商店披露原文判定，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。
description: 自己开硬件公司：设计手机、平板、笔记本、手表、耳机，连操作系统和自己的平台都一并做出来，一路当上设备厂商老板。

english.summary: A hardware company business simulator released on Oct 16, 2026, developed and published by Roastery Games. The store disclosure is one sentence: generative AI was used to assist in the creation of some fictional company logos featured in the game. Only the art area is recorded as used, while run-time generation, code, music, voice, writing, translation and marketing are recorded as not addressed.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer and publisher both Roastery Games) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 249), where no topic matches the AI keyword set, so there was no related thread to open. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 1 raw source was read: a GameDB.ai entry summarising the disclosure as AI helping create some fictional company logos, which that site states is read from each game Steam disclosure, i.e. a transcription. The other results were the store page and the same page through a recommendation entry, an Instagram reel item, a price-comparison entry for a similarly named different game (TechDev Tycoon) and a Reddit game-design post about someone building a tycoon game that does not identify itself as this title and could not be read because neither the direct route nor the local proxy completed a TLS handshake. An empty press finding only describes this search scope and is not evidence that no AI was used. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text and rests on the developer own statement, without an independent audit.

aiAreaNotes.art: The disclosure states that generative AI assisted in the creation of some fictional company logos featured in the game. How many logos fall under some, and which ones, is not stated on the store page.
